notes: Repo hygiene (L1 dispatch tooling): explained the 4.9 MB bin/managent and pinned the build mode. CAUSE: build.zig:48 used `b.standardOptimizeOption(.{})` with no preferred release mode, so a bare `zig build` (and `zig build deploy`) defaulted to Debug — the deployed bin/managent (2026-08-22, 4,938,144 bytes) is a Debug build, ~4.5x the prior 1.1 MB root binary. MODE DETERMINATION (arm64): deployed __text section = 3,348,804 bytes, byte-identical to a fresh `zig build-exe -O Debug` of the same source; Debug emits DWARF section names and 9,106 symbols vs 3,108 in ReleaseSafe. SIZE TABLE (bytes, arm64, same source): Debug 4,919,984 (__text 3,348,804, __eh_frame 416,564); ReleaseSafe 1,542,808 (__text 1,107,408); ReleaseFast 1,655,544 (__text 1,255,264); ReleaseSmall 641,480 (__text 395,204). Deployed-after-codesign ReleaseSafe = 1,560,944. DECISION: deployed binaries must be ReleaseSafe (correctness convention, AGENTS.md 'Correctness runs use ReleaseSafe — asserts are no-ops in ReleaseFast'; a management tool must not silently corrupt state). FIX: build.zig now reads `const optimize = b.option(std.builtin.OptimizeMode, "optimize", ...) orelse .ReleaseSafe;` — NB b.standardOptimizeOption's .preferred_optimize_mode field is NOT sufficient: in Zig 0.16 it only selects the mode for the legacy -Drelease flag, a bare build still returns .Debug (verified against std/Build.zig:1378). The explicit `orelse .ReleaseSafe` pins the bare-build default; -Doptimize=Debug/Fast/Small still override.
